A number of the judicial officers provide tentative rulings, posted on the Internet for the convenience of attorneys and parties. All Internet postings are gathered at this site and can be accessed by clicking on the name of the judicial officer. Tentative rulings are typically posted by 4:00 PM on the day before the scheduled hearing date.
